theorems.name: Submission.dorag_dbs_sharp_mass_ratio
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (κ δ ρ : ℝ) (z : Euclid P), 0 < ρ → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 / 8 → 0 ≤ κ → κ * ρ ≤ δ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ W → μ (closedBall z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → (∀ (y : Euclid P) (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → s < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * s) / s ^ n) * μ (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * μ (closedBall y t)) → ∀ y ∈ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * μ (closedBall y t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp δ * (1 + δ) / (1 - 4 * δ) ^ n) * unitBallVolume n ∧ μ (closedBall y t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp δ * (1 + δ) / (1 - 4 * δ) ^ n) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n)
